exp.desc:
- Team of five
- New menu, costing
- Up to 400 drinks on Fridays

cl.p1: on a Friday night three of us make around 400 drinks in our bar. That made me fast. What I miss there is time for guests: explaining a whisky, tuning a drink to someone’s taste, telling the story behind a gin. That is what I value about hotel bars.
cl.p2: I have six years behind the bar, three as head bartender. I have rewritten our menu twice, cost recipes and train new staff. I would happily do a trial shift on one of your busiest evenings.

letters.label: Head bartender moving to a hotel bar

cl.p1: three years on the restaurant floor, helping out at the bar every other night, have shown me that I am happier behind it. For the past year I have practised the classics at home and done a weekend bar course.
cl.p2: I know your bar as a guest and like that you work with a few good ingredients. I am quick, tidy and friendly when it gets busy, and I like learning from experienced people.
